Natural Grocers® is extending its 71st Anniversary celebration with a one-day Anniversary Afterparty on Aug. 27, featuring encore savings, member perks and a chance to win free groceries for a year.


Loyalty members get one more chance to enjoy up to 52% off hundreds of premium-quality items during the retailer's 71st Anniversary encore event


LAKEWOOD, Colo.


, Aug. 24, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Natural Grocers®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757625-1&h=4290405995&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=Natural+Grocers%C2%AE) , the largest family-operated organic and natural grocery retailer in the U.S., is keeping the celebration going with a one-day[Anniversary Afterparty](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757625-1&h=493591406&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fanniversary-after-party&a=Anniversary+Afterparty) on Thursday, Aug. 27. For one day only, {N}power® members can enjoy an encore opportunity to save up to 52% off hundreds of items throughout the store and score a few additional afterparty perks. Additionally, all customers will have the chance to **win free groceries for a year** ($6,000 value) by submitting an official entry form, available at all Natural Grocers locations on Aug. 27.\[i\]


Natural Grocers® extends its 71st Anniversary celebration with a one-day Anniversary Afterparty.


**ENCORE SAVINGS AND PERKS FOR {N}POWER MEMBERS**


On **August 27,** Natural Grocers offers {N}power members Anniversary Afterparty Savings of up to[52% off hundreds of products](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757625-1&h=713989233&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fanniversary-deals%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dnational-event-anniversary-2026&a=52%25+off+hundreds+of+products) throughout the store.\[ii\] The company is also offering its loyalty members freebies and a final chance for an *eggs-xtraordinary* BOGO offer.


- Featured afterparty deals include Simple Mills® Almond Flour Crackers (2/$5), select 32 oz, Ancient Nutrition Multi Collagen Protein, Vanilla or unflavored ($29.99 each), C2O® Coconut Waters ($19.99/12 pack), Truly Grass-Fed™ Naturally Creamy Butters ($3.25/8 oz), Caboo® Tree-Free Bath Tissue ($7.79/12 ct) and hundreds more.
- Free limited-edition reusable bag with purchase for {N}power members.\[iii\]
- {N}power members can also enjoy one free 17.5 ounce can of C2O® Coconut Water (no minimum purchase required, one per account). Members must click to load the offer to their account from the Natural Grocers mobile app, {N}power email or online dashboard before checkout.\[iv\]
- {N}power members who purchase one dozen Contented Hen® or one dozen Natural Grocers® Brand (any variety), will receive a second dozen of lesser or equal value free.\[v\]


*{N}power is Natural Grocers' free rewards program, offering members access to exclusive discounts, digital offers and special promotions. Customers can join by visiting*[www.naturalgrocers.com/npower](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757625-1&h=1611065693&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower&a=www.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower) *or*[downloading the Natural Grocers Mobile App](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757625-1&h=3725979871&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fmobile-app%3Futm_source%3Dpr%26utm_medium%3Dpress-release%26utm_campaign%3Dng-app&a=downloading+the+Natural+Grocers+Mobile+App) *.*

**ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE**
Founded in 1955, Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc. (NYSE: NGVC) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its[Five Founding Principles](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757625-1&h=3796310652&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-five-founding-principles&a=Five+Founding+Principles) —including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 174 stores in 22 states. Visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4757625-1&h=4230922481&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=naturalgrocers.com) for more information and store locations.
